_readme: Copy this file to doctors.json in the same folder, then replace the entries
below with real contacts. doctors.json is gitignored so private details stay
off version control.
Only 'name' and 'specialty' are required. Everything else can be omitted and
the card simply leaves that line out.
'specialty' must be one of: emergency_medicine, general_medicine, cardiology,
pulmonology, neurology, gastroenterology, urology, orthopaedics, ent,
ophthalmology, dentistry, dermatology, psychiatry, gynaecology, paediatrics.
'photo' takes a URL or a path the browser can reach. Leave it null and the UI
draws the doctor's initials in a coloured circle. Do not add a photo of anyone
without their permission.
'phone' and 'whatsapp' are turned into tap-to-call and tap-to-chat links, so
include the country code. Anything non-numeric is stripped before dialling.
'lat' and 'lng' let the app sort doctors by distance from the patient. Get
them by right-clicking the clinic in Google Maps and copying the numbers.
Both are needed or neither is used. The patient's own location stays in
their browser and is never sent anywhere.
'hours' drives the open/closed badge. Each day holds a list of intervals, so
a clinic with separate morning and evening sittings is written as two pairs.
Leave a day out, or give it [], to mark it closed. Use
{"always_open": true} for a 24-hour emergency department.
'timings' is the human-readable line on the card. Leave it out and it is
generated from 'hours' automatically.
